candidates.api_shape: crossed_roller(d, rollers, roller_d, width) rotary, or crossed_roller_way(length, travel) linear. Races + bought needles at alternating 90 deg
candidates.fdm: Printed V-races, bought needle rollers. Rotary: compact moment-stiff wrist. Linear: two V-rails and a cage, stroke limited (non-recirc). Prints. Wear is the race.
candidates.name: crossed_roller
candidates.why: Alternating 90-deg rollers carry radial, thrust, and moment in one thin section. Robot wrists, CMMs, rotary tables. Not a ball bearing (point contact, no moment) and not a sliding way. The missing precision rolling pair.

candidates.fdm: A V-slot rail (printed or a bought 2020 V-slot stand-in) plus crowned V-wheels. The OpenBuilds / printer-gantry rolling way. Wheels can be printed TPU/PETG or bought Delrin. Most FDM-native rolling guide.
candidates.name: v_wheel_rail
candidates.why: V-wheel on a V-rail. linear_way vee is a sliding pair that needs hold-down. This rolls. The hobby linear default, and it is not in-tree.

candidates.api_shape: linear_ball_bushing(shaft_d, balls, circuits) -> {nut, balls} on a round shaft. Teaching analog; balls bought
candidates.fdm: Printed nut with gothic grooves or recirculating tracks, bought balls, bought or printed shaft. Same honesty as printed_ball_bearing: not a service LM12UU. The printer-axis request.
candidates.name: linear_ball_bushing
candidates.why: Recirculating balls on a round shaft (Thomson / LM). The other linear rolling family next to crossed-roller and V-wheel. plain_bushing slides; this rolls.

candidates.api_shape: lip_seal(shaft_d, lip_t, housing_d, kind='radial'|'wiper') -> TPU ring or a housing groove for a bought TC seal
candidates.fdm: A TPU garter-less lip, or a pocket that takes a bought radial shaft seal. labyrinth_seal is non-contact dust; this is the contact oil seal. Print the housing; the lip is elastomer.
candidates.name: lip_seal
candidates.why: Radial shaft / oil seal. Rotating shaft, grease or oil stays in. oring_groove is a static gland; labyrinth is a comb. The missing dynamic contact seal.

candidates.api_shape: piston_ring(bore_d, t, h, gap, n=1) -> split rings + piston grooves
candidates.fdm: A split (or printed-gap) ring in a piston groove. PETG/TPU. The gap is the leak and the install. Hydraulic cylinder (previous slice) needs this to be honest.
candidates.name: piston_ring
candidates.why: Reciprocating seal on a piston OD. Engines, compressors, printed syringes. Not an O-ring (which is a static/slow gland) and not a lip (which rides a shaft).

candidates.api_shape: wiper(rod_d or way_section, lip) -> a scraper facing dirt, often stacked with a lip_seal
candidates.fdm: A TPU lip aimed at incoming dirt, not at the oil. Prints as a cap on a rod or a carriage end. Way covers / bellows are a product.
candidates.name: wiper
candidates.why: Scraper / dirt wiper. Linear rods and hydraulic rams. Distinct from a lip seal (retains lubricant) by facing the other way. Cheap and named.

candidates.api_shape: needle_cage(n, needle_d, length, race_d) -> printed cage + bought needles
candidates.fdm: A printed cage. Needles are bought. Drawn-cup HF one-way cups stay hardware (clockwork/clutches already said so). This is the radial needle stand-in.
candidates.name: needle_roller
candidates.why: Needle roller: high load, thin section. The prompt listed it. Not a ball and not a sprag. Cage is the printable part.

candidates.api_shape: linear_way(profile='box') square-section with a gib on one face
candidates.fdm: A rectangular rail, carriage wraps three or four faces. Machine-tool box way. After dovetail/vee/tslot, a fourth profile.
candidates.name: box_way
candidates.why: Classic mill column way. Capture is from wrap + gib, not an undercut. A profile= argument, not a second module.

candidates.fdm: Covered. ydovetail is a Y-assembly cutter, not a running way.
candidates.name: dovetail_way
candidates.why: Prompt listed dovetail as missing. It is the default linear_way profile. Do not add a second dovetail.

candidates.fdm: Covered as a sliding vee. The rolling cousin is v_wheel_rail.
candidates.name: vee_way
candidates.why: Already a linear_way profile. The gap is the rolling V-wheel, not a second sliding vee.

candidates.fdm: Prints a pocketed pad. Needs a compressor, restrictors, and a lapped surface.
candidates.name: air_bearing
candidates.why: Aerostatic. Out. A printed pad is a fixture around bought hardware.

candidates.name: magnetic_bearing
candidates.why: Active or passive magnetic. Coils or magnets. Same reject as magnetic_gear / magnetic_clutch.

rejected.name: hiwin_profile_rail
rejected.why: Recirculating ball carriage on a ground profile rail. Product. linear_ball_bushing is the printable teaching analog.

rejected.name: tapered_roller_cup
rejected.why: Timken cone and cup. Ground metal. Crossed-roller is the printable moment-stiff stand-in.

rejected.name: pillow_block
rejected.why: A housing around a bushing or a bought bearing. Product built from plain_bushing + bearing_seat.

rejected.name: mechanical_face_seal
rejected.why: John Crane lapped faces + spring. Product / hardware.

sources: mechlib/bearings.py (plain_bushing, thrust_washer, printed_ball_bearing), mechlib/guides.py (linear_way dovetail/vee/tslot, telescoping_stage), mechlib/cutters.py (oring_groove, labyrinth_seal, gasket_channel, bearing_seat, ydovetail), mechlib/usecases.py
summary:
A bearing constrains relative motion and carries load; a way is a prismatic bearing; a seal keeps fluid or dirt on one side. Reuleaux's rolling higher pair is the rolling bearing; the prismatic lower pair is the way; a seal is not a pair. Norton/Slocum split bearings by contact (plain vs rolling vs fluid-film vs magnetic) and by load (radial, thrust, moment). Linear families are sliding (dovetail, vee, box, t-slot), rolling (recirculating profile rail, ball bushing, crossed-roller non-recirc, V-wheel), and aerostatic. Seals split contact (lip, O-ring, piston ring, wiper, packing) vs non-contact (labyrinth, viscoseal). 507 barely names them (anti-friction rolls 250, 270). Howell's 'bearing' is a flexure pivot, already in-tree.

Catalog already covers the printable staples. Radial plain: plain_bushing (sleeve/flange, grease grooves, lead-in). Radial rolling: printed_ball_bearing (print-in-place truncated races, honest FDM limits, buy a 608 for load). Thrust: thrust_washer (pads/pockets/flat, or pair=True ball-thrust with bought balls). Ways: linear_way already ships profile='dovetail'|'vee'|'tslot' plus a tapered gib. telescoping_stage is keyed square tubes. flexure_stage is the compliant way. Seals: oring_groove (face or bore, squeeze/fill gated), labyrinth_seal (interleaved comb, the printable rotary seal), gasket_channel (non-round cord). Cutters: bearing_seat (608 pocket), ydovetail (assembly tongue, not a running way). The prompt's 'dovetail way' and 'V-way' are therefore not gaps: they are arguments on linear_way. Grep finds no crossed-roller, needle roller, linear ball bushing, V-wheel rail, lip/shaft seal, piston ring, or wiper.

FDM reality. Crossed-roller (rotary or linear) is alternating 90-deg cylinders between V-races: high stiffness, the CMM/robot wrist bearing. Print the races, buy needles. Linear ball bushing (LM on a round shaft) is the printer-axis request; printed balls fail, bought balls in a printed nut is a teaching analog of printed_ball_bearing. V-wheel on a V-rail (OpenBuilds) is the most FDM-native rolling way: printed or bought Delrin wheels, an aluminium V-slot or a printed rail. Needle-roller stand-in is a cage of bought needles in a printed cup, not a drawn HF bearing. Lip / shaft seal is a TPU or bought elastomer ring in a housing groove; labyrinth already covers the non-contact rotary case. Piston ring is a split (or printed-gap) ring on a piston OD. Wiper/scraper is a lip facing dirt on a rod or way. Air and magnetic bearings are out (compressor + restrictors, or coils/magnets). Recirculating Hiwin rails and tapered-roller cups are products / ground metal. A pillow block is a housing around a bushing, a product.
title: Bearings, ways, and seals
